subject: Which deadline is current?
text: Sorry to circle back so quickly, but after checking the notes I made two days ago I am still not certain which deadline actually governs the volunteer signup sheet. On the group call I wrote down that forms were due by Friday, yet the shared checklist seems to show Monday evening instead, and the two dates would completely change how I schedule the rest of the week. If the Friday date is wrong, can you confirm that in writing so I can pass the correction to the others? If Monday is correct, I still need a little more information about whether that is the final cutoff or only the deadline for the first round of assignments, because I think several people assume it is the full end date. I did not want to send another question to the whole team and create more confusion, so I am asking you directly. The reason this feels urgent is that I need to know by tomorrow afternoon whether I should move the reminder email from Saturday to Thursday. I also noticed the poster draft includes a deadline that matches the checklist, but the caption under it references a different date, so we may need to decide whether the poster has to be changed before printing. If you have a moment, just reply with the exact deadline for the signup sheet and, if relevant, the poster correction. If there is a single place where the authoritative date lives, point me to it. Sorry again for the rush.
